headline: Gold falls more than 1% and heads for its worst week in 8 months, with focus on the Fed
summary: Gold extended its steep decline on Friday, trading near a more than one-year low. It was on track for its biggest weekly drop in eight months, with attention on the Federal Reserve.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value whose price tends to react to real interest rates and Federal Reserve policy expectations.
why_moved: The article links gold's decline to the Federal Reserve outlook, with prices heading for their largest weekly fall in eight months.
original_headline: El oro ca más de 1% y se encamina a su peor semana en 8 meses con foco puesto en la Fed
